question: Name the first Indian woman to win a Gold at Paralympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avani Lekhara.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Avani Lekhara** became the primary Indian to achieve a **gold medal at the Paralympic Games.**
 
• She went on to **clinch bronze at a later event thus becoming the first Indian woman to achieve multiple Paralympic medals.**
 
• Lekhara lost her legs</s
